name: Chromecast
description: Adds Google Cast (Chromecast) devices to Jellyfin's built-in "Play On" cast interface, on every client - including the iOS/iPadOS/macOS apps, which have no Google Cast SDK of their own and can't use the Chrome-only cast button that jellyfin-web ships with. Discovered Chromecast devices are registered as Jellyfin sessions, the same way the built-in DLNA "Play To" feature works, so they show up automatically wherever you'd cast from. Casting itself is handed off to Jellyfin's own bundled cast receiver app - the exact same one Chrome and Android users already cast to - so transcoding, subtitles, and codec negotiation (including transcoding H.265/HEVC sources that older Chromecast hardware can't decode) work the same way they already do there, instead of being reimplemented. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or later.
overview: Cast to Google Cast devices from Jellyfin's built-in cast interface, on every client including iOS/iPadOS/macOS.

versions.changelog: Fixes switching subtitle or audio tracks mid-cast from the remote-control UI, which was previously a silent no-op (the receiver command was never sent). No changes to initial-cast subtitle behavior, which still depends on the casting client's own subtitle selection at the time it starts the cast.

First public test release. Confirmed working against real Chromecast hardware and the iOS/macOS apps: discovery, casting, H.265/HEVC transcoding, play/pause/unpause/stop/seek/skip/volume/mute, queueing and queue navigation, live playback state in the remote control screen, picking up an in-progress cast from a second device, and access token cleanup on stop. Early release - please report anything that doesn't work as expected. See https://github.com/DD00031/jellyfin-plugin-chromecast/blob/main/CLAUDE.md for full technical background.
